records.purpose: Resolve an exact bounded name to an owner-bound session trigger token; unknown names return NOT_FOUND and zero output without playback.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*resolve)(sco_plugin* self, const char* name, uint64_t* out_trigger);`
Resolve an exact bounded name to an owner-bound session trigger token; unknown names return NOT_FOUND and zero output without playback.
records.ownership: Live caller owns trigger and playback tokens. No native pointers or cross-boundary allocation; tokens never reused within process.
records.callback_context: No plugin callbacks. Host backend synchronous, bounded and nonthrowing.
records.reentrancy: Recursive operations fail with FAILED; owner release during backend call drains cleanup on return.
records.results: OK accepted; BAD_ARG invalid owner/input; WRONG_THREAD; NOT_FOUND unknown/stale/wrong-kind; FAILED foreign owner or backend failure; TOO_MANY quota; UNAVAILABLE unbound, revoked, stopped or restart-required. Output tokens zero on failure.
records.absent_capability: game.audio.triggers OFF without a bound host provider; no native backend, not run in game.
records.cleanup: Owner unload stops only owned effects. Failed stop retains effect/context and cleanup hook; new effects remain unavailable even after recovery.
limitations: Synthetic host evidence only; no native or audible playback verification.

records.purpose: Submit one fire-and-forget trigger request; no playback token, no audible-output or completion guarantee, no stop.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*play_once)(sco_plugin* self, uint64_t trigger);`
Submit one fire-and-forget trigger request; no playback token, no audible-output or completion guarantee, no stop.
records.ownership: Live caller owns the trigger token from resolve. No playback token is issued; no native pointers or cross-boundary allocation.
records.callback_context: No plugin callbacks. Host backend synchronous, bounded and nonthrowing.
records.reentrancy: Recursive operations fail with FAILED; owner release during backend call drains cleanup on return.
records.results: OK accepted submission only; BAD_ARG invalid owner/input; WRONG_THREAD; NOT_FOUND unknown/stale/wrong-kind trigger; FAILED foreign owner, backend refusal or recursion; CRASHED backend fault (play_once then OFF until restart); UNAVAILABLE unbound, revoked, stopped, restart-required, a 1.0-sized table, or owner released during an accepted call (no rollback, do not retry).
records.absent_capability: game.audio.play_once OFF without a bound host provider; independent of game.audio.triggers; no native backend, not run in game.
records.cleanup: Nothing to clean up per call: no playback is tracked. Owner unload needs no stop; an accepted submission cannot be cancelled.
limitations: Synthetic host evidence only; no native backend and no audible playback verification.
